# TreeView

**Class:** `UltraCanvasTreeView` · **Group:** [Navigation and data views](../Groups/Navigation-and-data-views.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTreeView.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTreeView.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasTreeView.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

List **or table** — `UltraCanvasListView` is the multi-column, virtualised, model-driven one (`IListModel` + `ListColumnDef` + delegates; `SetShowHeader(true)` gives resizable columns, header tooltips and a sort indicator; sort and filter it with [`UltraCanvasListSortFilterProxy`](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasListSortFilterProxy.md)); tree; multi-column tree ([`UltraCanvasColumnsTreeView`](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasTreeViewExamples.md#columnar-layout-ultracanvascolumnstreeview): aligned Name / Type / Value columns with a header band, resizable boundaries and section-header rows); sheet

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasTreeView(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasTreeView(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasTreeView(const std::string& identifier = "TreeView");
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onNodeSelected` | `std::function<void(TreeNode*)> onNodeSelected` | _Node selected_ |
| `onNodeDoubleClicked` | `std::function<void(TreeNode*)> onNodeDoubleClicked` | _Node double clicked_ |
| `onNodeExpanded` | `std::function<void(TreeNode*)> onNodeExpanded` | _Node expanded_ |
| `onNodeCollapsed` | `std::function<void(TreeNode*)> onNodeCollapsed` | _Node collapsed_ |
| `onNodeCheckChanged` | `std::function<void(TreeNode*, TreeCheckState)> onNodeCheckChanged` | A row's check flag changed - by a click on the box, the space bar, or one of the Set*Checked calls. Fires once per node whose state actually moved, propagated parents and children included. |
| `onNodeDragDrop` | `std::function<void(TreeNode*, TreeNode*)> onNodeDragDrop` | A row dragged onto another and released there (SetNodeDragEnabled): the row dragged, then the row it was dropped on. Fired after the drag has ended, so the handler may rebuild the tree. dragged, target |
| `onNodeDragAccept` | `std::function<bool(TreeNode* dragged, TreeNode* target)> onNodeDragAccept` | Whether `dragged` may be dropped on `target`: only a row it accepts is drawn as the drop target and fires onNodeDragDrop. Unset, every row is accepted but the dragged one and those inside it - a node cannot be put into itself. |
| `onFilesDragAccept` | `std::function<bool(TreeNode* target)> onFilesDragAccept` | Files dragged in from elsewhere (the file list, another app) and dropped on a node. `onFilesDragAccept` decides whether a node is a valid drop target - only accepted nodes get the drop highlight. `onFilesDroppedOnNode` performs the drop and returns whether it handled it. |
| `onFilesDroppedOnNode` | `std::function<bool(TreeNode* target, const std::vector<std::string>& files)> onFilesDroppedOnNode` | _Files dropped on node_ |
| `onDropFolderOfNode` | `std::function<std::string(TreeNode* node)> onDropFolderOfNode` | The local folder `node` stands for, or "" when it stands for none. Asked when a Save dialog's file icon from another window or program is dropped on a node onFilesDragAccept accepts (a Drop carrying UCEvent::dropFolderReply): the file is saved in that folder. |
| `onNodeRightClicked` | `std::function<void(TreeNode*, const UCEvent&)> onNodeRightClicked` | Right mouse button released over a node. The event is passed along so a handler can open a context menu at the pointer (event.pointerWindow). A right press never changes the selection — the menu acts on the node it was opened over, while the selected node stays where it was. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `TreeNodeState`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Collapsed = 0` |  |
| `Expanded = 1` |  |
| `Leaf = 2` | No children, no expand/collapse button |

### enum `TreeSelectionMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoSelection = 0` | No selection allowed |
| `Single = 1` | Only one node can be selected |
| `Multiple = 2` | Multiple nodes can be selected |

### enum `TreeLineStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoLine = 0` | No connecting lines |
| `Dotted = 1` | Dotted connecting lines |
| `Solid = 2` | Solid connecting lines |

### enum `TreeExpanderStyle`

How the expand button of a row with children looks

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Box = 0` | + or - in a square (the default) |
| `Chevron = 1` | an arrow: pointing right when closed, down when open |

### enum `TreeCheckState`

State of the optional checkbox a row carries when the tree runs with SetShowCheckboxes(true). Mixed is the parent state a partly-checked subtree produces while check propagation is on (see SetCheckPropagation).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Unchecked = 0` |  |
| `Checked = 1` |  |
| `Mixed = 2` |  |

### enum `TreeSortMode`

Ordering applied to a node's children. LastAccess orders by TreeNodeData::accessSequence (largest first when ascending=false), which callers stamp when a value is touched. NB: value is NoSort (not "None") deliberately — <X11/Xlib.h>, pulled in by the Linux backend, #defines `None`, which would mangle an enumerator named None.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoSort = 0` | preserve insertion order |
| `Alphabetic = 1` | by display name (data.text), case-insensitive |
| `LastAccess = 2` | by data.accessSequence |

### struct `TreeScrollToTopStyle`

Look and thresholds of the floating buttons the tree draws over the bottom-right corner of its content area: "move to the top" (once the rows overflow the visible area and the view has been scrolled down) and, stacked directly above it, "go to the selected entry" (while the selected row is out of view). Both buttons share this style. See UltraCanvasTreeView::SetShowScrollToTopButton() and UltraCanvasTreeView::SetShowScrollToSelectionButton().

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `size` | `int size = 24` | button width/height in px |
| `margin` | `int margin = 8` | gap between a button and the content edges / the other button |
| `minHiddenRows` | `int minHiddenRows = 3` | top button: show only when MORE than this many rows are out of view |
| `cornerRadius` | `float cornerRadius = 12.0f` | 0 =&gt; square; &gt;= size/2 =&gt; fully rounded |
| `background` | `Color background = Color(0x3C, 0x3C, 0x3C, 0xC0)` | translucent so rows stay readable |
| `hoverBackground` | `Color hoverBackground = Color(0x1E, 0x1E, 0x1E, 0xF0)` |  |
| `borderColor` | `Color borderColor = Color(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0x60)` |  |
| `arrowColor` | `Color arrowColor = Colors::White` |  |

One cell value for a column tree view (see UltraCanvasColumnsTreeView). The tree/name column reads its text from TreeNodeData::text; every other column reads its cell from TreeNodeData::cells, keyed by the column's id.

| `backgroundColor` | `Color backgroundColor = Colors::Transparent` | Background color (transparent by default) |
| `tooltip` | `std::string tooltip` | Tooltip text |
| `userData` | `void* userData = nullptr` | Custom user data |
| `checkState` | `TreeCheckState checkState = TreeCheckState::Unchecked` |  |
| `showCheckbox` | `bool showCheckbox = true` | false: the row keeps the slot but draws no box |
| `cells` | `std::map<std::string, TreeCellData> cells` | The base tree renders a single line from `text`. A column tree view treats `text` as the tree/name column and reads `cells` (keyed by column id) for every other column. `cells` is ignored by the base tree, so setting it is always safe. per-column values, keyed by TreeViewColumn::id |
| `isGroupHeader` | `bool isGroupHeader = false` | Render this row as a full-width section-header bar (Line/Loop/...) |
| `accessSequence` | `uint64_t accessSequence = 0` | Ordering key for TreeSortMode::LastAccess. Callers stamp a monotonically increasing value each time the variable is read/written so the most recently accessed entries can float to the top. |
| `loading` | `bool loading = false` | The node's children are being fetched - a lazy-loading host waiting on a server: the row slides a thin bar along its foot (the tree's loadingBarColor) until the host clears this and redraws. In place of a placeholder child whose text says "loading"; the host keeps such a child only for the expand button, hidden … |
| `dimmed` | `bool dimmed = false` | The row reads as secondary - an entry the host normally leaves out (a hidden folder shown because the user went there): its label is drawn in the tree's dimmedTextColor, which follows the theme, instead of the text colour. A textColor of its own and the selection text still win. |
